University of Toronto.portal_login_note: Apply via the OUAC Undergraduate application (Group A if you're a current Ontario high-school student, Group B otherwise); supplementary essays for some faculties.

University of British Columbia.portal_login_note: Direct application; Personal Profile (5 short answers) submitted within the application.

McGill University.portal_login_note: Direct uApply; minimal supplements. Faculty-by-faculty admission.

University of Waterloo.portal_login_note: Apply via the OUAC Undergraduate application. Engineering, math, and CS applicants MUST complete the Admission Information Form (AIF) — heavily weighted in the decision.

Queen's University.portal_login_note: OUAC Undergraduate application + Personal Statement of Experience (PSE) for most programs.

Western University.portal_login_note: OUAC Undergraduate application. Most programs grades-only; some scholarship apps separate.

McMaster University.portal_login_note: OUAC Undergraduate application. Health Sciences and Arts & Science programs require supplementary applications.

University of Alberta.portal_login_note: ApplyAlberta provincial portal for Alberta universities.

University of Ottawa.portal_login_note: OUAC Undergraduate application. April 1 is the late deadline; earlier applications get earlier offers.

Toronto Metropolitan University.portal_login_note: OUAC Undergraduate application. Some programs (RTA, Image Arts, Fashion) require supplementary portfolio.

York University.portal_login_note: OUAC Undergraduate application. Most programs grades-driven.
